rationale: FWONK has gapped up ~6.9% on 7x relative volume with no news catalyst identified, suggesting event-driven flow that is difficult to fade or chase without understanding the driver. The broader market is under significant stress (SPY -3.02%, VIXY +18%), which creates conflicting pressure — the gap strength is impressive but the macro environment argues against adding long exposure, while shorting a stock showing this kind of relative strength against a down tape is equally risky. With price sitting mid-range at 65.7% and no clear structural edge in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify a new position alongside the existing working order.
